newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain plans public offer for Argentaria.
newsitem.headline: Spain plans public offer for Argentaria.

text.p: Spain is still planning to sell its nearly 30 percent stake in Corporacion Bancaria de Espana (Argentaria) via a public share offering, Director General of State Assets Pablo Isla said on Wednesday.

Braulio Medel, chairman of savings banks association CECA, said on Tuesday that some savings banks would be interested in participating in the sale, and press reports today said the operation might be made via auction, as in the case of second telephone operator Retevision.
"The intention of the state is to sell the stake via a public share offering in the national and international markets," Isla said in a statement.

"This will be structured in different tranches (retail, Spanish institutions, international institutions) and will take place at what is considered to be the most appropriate moment," the statement added.
The Spanish state still owns 29.2 percent of Argentaria.
